meta.name: get-unpublished-changes
meta.description: Compare HEAD with the latest published npm versions and list all unpublished changes by release layer. Triggers: unpublished changes, changelog, what changed, whats new.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 列出尚未发布的 npm 改动,按发布层级分组。
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果想把本地改动与已发布版本对比,发布前心中有数。
copy.tagline_en: See what changed since the last published npm release.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to review unpublished changes before releasing.

howto.what: 装上后，Claude 会立即对比 HEAD 与最新已发布的 npm 版本，读实际 diff 用白话描述每处改动，按发布层列出未发布内容，并给出各层与整体的版本号建议。
howto.when: 当你说出「unpublished changes」「changelog」等触发词，或询问哪些改动还没发布时接管。

say.text: 列出所有还没发布的改动，按发布层分组
say.note: 会输出分层影响矩阵和各层版本建议

say.text: 对比 HEAD 和最新发布的 npm 版本，说明真实改了什么
say.note: 读 diff 而非复述 commit message

say.text: lazycodex-ai 该升 patch 还是 minor？
say.note: 按 codex 层给出具体版本号建议

howto.what_en: Once installed, Claude immediately compares HEAD with the latest published npm versions, reads the real diffs, describes each change in plain language, lists unpublished changes per release layer, and recommends version bumps.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you mention "unpublished changes", "changelog" or "what changed" (also "whats new"), or ask which changes are not yet published.

say_en.text: List every unpublished change, grouped by release layer
say_en.note: Outputs a layered impact matrix and version advice

say_en.text: Diff HEAD against the latest published npm versions and describe the real changes
say_en.note: Reads diffs instead of restating commit messages

say_en.text: Should lazycodex-ai take a patch or minor bump?
